tools.name: account_info
tools.description: Get the Linode account profile: contact details, balance and enabled capabilities

needs_review: Tools and response picks read from the official Linode API v4 reference (techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference) on 2026-09-12: instance fields (label, region, type, status, image, ipv4, ipv6, specs.vcpus/memory/disk, tags, created, updated, hypervisor), volume fields (label, status, size, region, linode_id, linode_label, filesystem_path, hardware_type, encryption) and account fields (euuid, company, email, balance, balance_uninvoiced, billing_source, active_since, capabilities) are all present in the published schemas, as are the page/pages/results pagination envelope and the page/page_size query parameters (page_size documented 25 to 500, default 100; clamped to 25 to 100 here to keep payloads small).

Scaffolded auth (bearer api_token) and the scaffolded test path GET /v4/profile both stand: the live host rejects a dummy bearer with a structured 401 {"errors":[{"reason":"Invalid Token"}]} at /v4/profile and at every read path used here, which is the auth handling the docs describe. Nothing was changed.

No _probe hints are needed: linode_id is numeric, and Linode validates the token before routing on the identifier, so the harness's generic dummy input still lands on a structured 401 that differs from the control response. Credentials are never hinted.

Shape-proof control note: the control path sits at the host root, where api.linode.com answers 301 to an HTML redirect rather than a 4xx, so it contributes no differential. The classifications here rest on the structured JSON 401 at each documented path instead.
